title_suffix: safe Goal recovery and authorized review continuation
summary: OSpec 1.8.8 lets interrupted Goals resume without weakening workspace or review governance. Non-PENDING task targets, exact task-generated TypeScript build metadata, and current-version ospec update output have bounded ownership, while unknown, future-task, stale, or tampered paths still fail closed. An explicitly authorized extra design or plan review now receives one finite dispatch window even when the base 30-minute stage lifetime is exhausted. Hard Loop gates persist as blocked, bootstrap preserves valid technical notation, and the initial child claim target leaves a clear recovery buffer before lease expiry.
new: Added .ospec/update-provenance.json with current CLI version, exact managed paths, file or missing state, and SHA-256 hashes after ospec update.
Added a durable blocked Loop status for hard workflow gates, with explicit resume back to idle for gate reevaluation.
Added separate Goal-owned, task-generated, update-managed, and blocking workspace projections to JSON and Markdown status artifacts.
Added an observable one-time override dispatch window with decision, round, selected-at, deadline, remaining-time, and expiry fields.
improved: Existing Goals may retain dirty target paths only after their task leaves PENDING; future task targets and unrelated files remain isolated.
Update provenance covers created, refreshed, removed, migrated, plugin, knowledge, tooling, and both sides of archive-layout moves.
The initial unclaimed action heartbeat target is now 60 seconds before the five-minute lease expiry; claimed-action renewals retain the existing midpoint schedule.
Started tasks with declared build or typecheck verification may retain only the exact default tsconfig.tsbuildinfo beside the nearest owning tsconfig.json; no generated-file wildcard is used.
fixed: Fixed valid resumed Goals repeatedly stopping at needs_isolation because implementation files and ospec update output were indistinguishable from unrelated edits.
Fixed stale unused update provenance blocking an otherwise clean or Goal-owned workspace, while preserving tamper detection whenever provenance accepted a dirty path.
Fixed hard gates being persisted as running at the gate step and therefore appearing to make progress when no action could execute.
Fixed valid technical notation such as canonical <route>.json being treated as an unfinished document placeholder and routing an executing Goal backwards.
Fixed an exact user-authorized third design or plan review being rejected after repair and user-wait time exhausted the original 30-minute stage lifetime.
Fixed dedicated dirty Goal worktrees remaining blocked on package-local TypeScript build metadata produced by their own declared verification command.
docs: Documented confirmed device and browser workflow incidents, the Goal/task-generated workspace contract, update recovery procedure, blocked Loop semantics, and the remaining multi-child heartbeat fairness gap.
Documented a confirmed plan-review budget incident, one-time authorization window, expiry and reauthorization behavior, and preserved global safety guards.
